metadata.distance_rule: finish_round == number_of_rounds and elapsed finish_time == 300 seconds
metadata.target: elapsed rounds rounded up to the next 0.5 increment
metadata.feature_note: Exported statistics assumed pre-fight. Duration history uses only earlier event dates from raw fights, including rows outside the feature export.
metadata.evaluation: Chronological holdout, no hyperparameter tuning or walk-forward evaluation
metadata.duration_history: Lifetime and recent five bouts; opponent residual uses opponent mean available before that bout
